caption: The drawing depicts a single jug-shaped vessel and a smaller detail illustration beside it. The primary object is a blue glass pitcher with a wide, flat rim, a bulbous body, and a sturdy, flared base featuring vertical grooves. The vessel has a single, thick handle that curves upward and attaches below the rim and toward the upper section of the body. Four prominent, curved, vertical glass attachments are evenly spaced around the lower half of the body, extending from the shoulder toward the base. The additional illustration, presented in the bottom right within its own rectangular border, is an enlarged, detailed rendering of one of the curved glass attachments found on the main vessel. The entire drawing is rendered in shades of blue with highlights and shading to create a glass-like effect, and it is set within a simple, double-lined rectangular frame on an off-white or beige background. The artist's name, "John Tarantino," appears in the bottom right corner.
title: Pitcher
